author: EDJM9
body:
If anyone is reading this, I dont know where to put a ban appeal in, but I just got banned for no reason on Avicus. I was reported for fly hacking by resepignev when I clearly was not. I was ontop of a VISIBLE block, and there was someone who witnessed me ON A BLOCK.

Please read this, I enjoy playing on this server a lot.

-Robomaster22
